attrs.value: Hayne's secret pathway did its job. All that's left is the final stronghold for Durand.
How is it that you are silent, Argent?
This has been a long time coming for all of us. I'll be able to laugh about this one once it's all over.
Hayne. So it's true? You're a traitor. I did not expect you all so soon, which means he must have led you through our private pathways.
I never thought I'd have to kill you, Hayne. I almost feel bad about it.
Your time is over, Durand. Today will begin a new era, and the Dragoons will return to our home.
Lancers and Vultures! What the heck?! I just made that like a week ago and you already stole it. Dang, man. That's cold.
My spies are busy little bees. What can I say?
Enough. We're done with your tricks Durand. We're going to put an end to you.
I suppose you think you've won.
Our victory is clear. None of your defenses remain.
Your people will know what you've done Durand. They'll know they've spent years living in a wasteland due to the aftermath of a war you started. They will never accept you again.
Just execute me if there is nothing left for me.
You will go to prison as punishment for your crimes. Everyone will see what becomes of men like you.
Exactly. As long as I breathe, you will never have won. Never.
Get his sorry butt out of here! I'm tired of hearing him yap. You got schooled, chump! Schooled hard!
Did I miss the whole party?
We did not have a party. Today we had a glorious battle.
I always forget they're no good at that. Well, I'm proud of you boys. You did a fine job.

I don't know about you guys, but when I feel proud of someone, I like to shower them with cash. Lots and lots of cash. I'll be right over here when you're ready to start throwing stacks of money at me.
Welcome home, Yurik. It will be nice to have our old neighbors back where they belong.
You have done a brave thing, Tucker. You have risked your life in our cause. This makes us brothers.
Still waiting for my cash shower...
I'm pretty sure there are some Northern Fed parades waiting for you to be Grand Marshall of, Argent? Will you accept fame and an adoring nation instead of cash?
I could be persuaded. Will there be groupies?
Get out of here, all of you! Go! Go be heroes! You've earned it.
Could there have been any other outcome? I hate seeing someone waste their time the way those fools did.
